text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered for service=runtime-hotpath, route=/v1/generate. p99=2.9s (SLO=0.8s), SLO-burn=4.2x over 1m window. Auto-page INC-2026-8475 created and paging on-call.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-2026-8475 - paging eng-oncall @on-call. Severity: p99 latency spike.

alex: acked on PD, I'm looking now. Any customer-facing errors reported?

sam: I'm oncall, pulling dashboards. Not seeing elevated 5xxs, mostly tail latency on streaming endpoints. Which pool is hot?

maria: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/latency/hotpath?orgId=1 (short link) - p95 ~0.6s but p99 ~2.9s in last 3m, eu-west spikes. A handful of streaming sessions show long stalls.

jin: looking at node metrics -> KV cache eviction rate jump on hotpath nodes 3/4/5. Memory pressure + big embedding batch jobs coincide. Likely eviction thrash causing lots of cold KV misses and high CPU on attention kernels.

ops-bot: Runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-tail - suggested quick mitigations: scale hotpath pool, enable fallback routing to smaller quantized model, apply per-tenant streaming throttle.

alex: doing a manual scale now to buy time. Running platform scale --pool hotpath --replicas 8

incident-bot: Autoscaler event: scale 2 -> 4 triggered (automated), manual override requested by alex to 8.

sam: manual bump applied to 8 replicas. Watching p99.

maria: p99 dropped to ~1.1s after nodes registered, then edged back up to ~1.6s. Eviction still noisy. Recommend temporary routing fallback for large requests: route >2000 tokens to redwood-small-quant-v2.

jin: implementing routing rule now. Also applying temporary per-tenant throttle for streaming heavy clients. Patch example:

```
PATCH /config/tenant/streaming
{ "max_tokens_per_second": 200 }
```

alex: applied routing fallback and tenant throttle. Verifying.

pagerduty: INC-2026-8475 acknowledged by sam. Escalation: L2 notified (@maria).

maria: starting rolling cache-tune + restart on hotpath nodes (2 at a time). Increasing KV cache size on hotpath pool config and bumping memcache eviction thresholds.

ops-bot: Rolling restart initiated: node-3 -> draining -> restart, ETA ~6m per pair.

alex: restarting node-3 and node-4 now.

maria: after restart + cache tune, p99 stabilized to ~0.78s. SLO within target. Observed impact window ~10-12 minutes. Approx 4% of production requests saw >1.5s latency during peak. No elevated error rates.

sam: summary for PD/ops: mitigated via scale, routing fallback to quant model, tenant throttles, and cache tuning. Root cause looks like large batched embedding jobs causing KV cache eviction thrash on hotpath pool leading to cold-cache misses and CPU contention.

alex: closing PD incident INC-2026-8475 (mitigated). Adding notes to the incident. :white_check_mark:

maria: filing follow-up: action items - 1) traffic-shape heavy embedding jobs, 2) increase KV allocation to hotpath pool, 3) improve autoscaler hysteresis for burst workloads, 4) add alert for sustained KV eviction rate. I'll open PRs and link in the postmortem. Runbook updated.

jin: saved relevant logs/snippets -> /internal/logs/INC-2026-8475 and pushed an adhoc query for eviction spikes.

sam: thanks team. Closing thread once PD incident set to resolved.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-8475 status changed to RESOLVED by alex.
